owner_decision.question_verbatim: TEST_REPEAT 的输入锁卡在 1B_D8（另外 133 个 core 与 V9-G1 缓存逐位一致），最可能是 CPU 不同导致 numpy 走了不同的 SIMD 路径。继续需要读 1B_D8 的 TEST 原始文件做诊断（不做评估），并冻结 v5。怎么处理？
owner_decision.chosen_option_text_verbatim: 诊断确认是 CPU 路径造成的，就按 V9-G1 的 CPU 路径重新准备输入，判定标准不变，预计 134/134 通过。不是的话，就采用原始哈希已核对的 V10 重建版 1B_D8，另加一个排除它的 TEST133 敏感性集。

decision_rule_as_relayed.fixed: before the diagnostic result (the diagnostic job 1051581 was submitted after this decision)
decision_rule_as_relayed.A: if DIAG.json shows a CPU-dispatch artifact - one rebuild variant reproduces V9-G1's file bitwise, the raw members match, and V9-G1's file lies inside its prepare window - re-prepare into a new root with the numpy dispatch pinned to V9-G1's path; the criterion stays bitwise equality with V9-G1's cache; the sets and the 42 units are unchanged
decision_rule_as_relayed.B1: otherwise accept the raw-verified, deterministic V10 rebuild of 1B_D8, keep TEST134 as primary and add a pre-registered TEST133 sensitivity set (1B_D8 excluded); TEST112 is unaffected unless 1B_D8 is in it, in which case add the corresponding TEST111 sensitivity
decision_rule_as_relayed.C: if the rebuild is not deterministic or the raw files mismatch, stop and report: not covered by the owner's choice
